note: EgoDex and EgoVerse use publisher-provided human-video illustrations. EgoWE uses nine project-provided recordings, shown as short contiguous excerpts at their original playback speed. Robot head-camera training episodes from the public 0917 dataset snapshot are selected for complete tasks and steadier camera motion. Scenes are carpet-free except the explicitly approved bimanual clothes demonstration. For robot demonstrations, only initial pre-action lead-in may be removed for web playback. These are training examples, not evaluation demonstrations. Training-set statistics follow the final paper; the snapshot has matching aggregate duration and task-family totals.
